svg.title: The pair's 9 × 9 density matrix
svg.desc: The magnitudes of the 9 by 9 density matrix of the pair after the CPU simulation, rows and columns labelled by the levels of X1 then D2. Almost all of it sits in 01 (0.50) and 11 (0.49), with the coherence between them off the diagonal; levels 2 stay empty.
